title: Identity embedding of a configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, $S$ a type, $x$ a finite Boolean input word, and $c$ a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine on input $x$. For any assignment of contents and head positions to the $k$ work tapes, embedding $c$ into the same set of tapes by the identity embedding, with an empty output prefix, leaves $c$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a finite Boolean input word
